column1: How do you feel about our relationship? (Wary to Disdainful)dialogue needs to be confirmed
"I like you well enough. I like you more when you're not wasting time talking about things that don't matter."
column2: "Ugh, stop talking about feelings and our relationship! Let's just get back to doing fun things!"
column3: "Being around you almost makes me want to take Magister Irin's advice and go get my training in a guild. Staring at books all day has to be better than staring at your ugly mug."

column1: "We're fine. I don't really like getting into the sentimental stuff, so let's just leave it at that."
column2: "Do you even have to ask? What do you want me to do, spell it out with runes? I. Don't. Like. You."
column3: "Look, I'm only traveling with you because you go to interesting places. Doesn't mean I like being around you. Just be thankful I haven't turned you into anything while you're asleep."

column1: Let's talk about something else. (Returns to Greetings)
